The following events took place in '''1100 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ceases to function, beginning the [[Republic Dark Age]].<ref name="Atlas" />
*The Galactic Republic declares [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to be "nominally habitable."<ref name="ST">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref>
